name: Senryaku Musume
source:
Continent drowned in battle for territory. In this world only women can become military personnel since men are intelligently and mentally inferior to a women.
But one day a savior appears in one country, and the problem is that he is a man. That savior is you. Good luck!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-march-2002-kikokugai-cyber.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
大陆淹没在领土争夺的战火之中。在这个世界里，只有女性才能成为军人，因为男性在智力和精神上都逊色于女性。然而某天，一个国家出现了一位救世主，而问题在于——他是个男人。那位救世主就是你。祝你好运！

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-march-2002-kikokugai-cyber.html]vndbreview[/url]]
